def: MLCommons' industry benchmark suite for inference systems, with fixed models, accuracy targets and load scenarios: Offline, Server, SingleStream and MultiStream, plus an Interactive latency tier for LLMs.
practice: LLM tests cap TTFT and TPOT per scenario, for example 3 s and 80 ms for GPT-OSS-120B in Server as of November 2026; compare results only within one round and division, with system details.
